entries.name: Daily mission checklist
entries.summary: The recurring daily objectives that grant daily-mission points/rewards. Counts are the target quantity per day. The 'upgrade a building' and 'research a technology' objectives ALWAYS exist, but at high levels a single upgrade/research takes multiple days, so they complete every few days rather than strictly daily.

missions.note: Arena uses tickets, not stamina (see knowledge/arena.json).
Always available, but at high levels a single upgrade takes DAYS (e.g. 3, 8, 20 days), so the 'daily' completion actually lands every few days rather than every day.
Always available, but at high levels the shortest research is ~2 days, so completion is periodic (every 2-5 days), not strictly daily.

details.automation_note: Most of these map directly to bot tasks; several are already covered (train_troops, help_alliance). Order/queue them around march-queue limits (see knowledge/resources.json -> march-queues).
